title: k6 Load Test — Activity Upload & Extraction API

targets.query: SELECT sum("value") FROM "http_reqs" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT non_negative_derivative(sum("value"), 1s) as "req/s" FROM "http_reqs" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "http_req_failed" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)
SELECT last("value") FROM "vus" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)
SELECT percentile("value", 95) FROM "http_req_duration" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "errors_4xx" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT sum("value") FROM "errors_5xx" WHERE $timeFilter
